map.入射角对结果影响大吗？: Does the incidence angle affect the result much?
map.在科普或防灾教育中，对比不同尺度天体撞击的破坏范围（局部、区域、全球）。: In science education or disaster preparedness, compare the damage footprint of impacts at different scales (local, regional, global).
map.垂直撞击能量最集中；大入射角（掠射）时有效能量与坑形会变化，破坏范围更扁长但峰值: A vertical impact concentrates the energy most; at a large incidence angle (grazing) the effective energy and crater shape change, so the damage footprint is flatter and longer but with a smaller peak compression.
map.撞击坑为什么比陨石大得多？: Why is the crater much larger than the meteorite?
map.撞击能量远大于陨石自身化学能，主要由高速动能转化为冲击波与挖掘作用，坑径可达陨石: The impact energy far exceeds the chemical energy of the meteorite itself, coming mainly from high-speed kinetic energy converted into shock and excavation. The crater diameter can reach several to tens of times the meteorite diameter.
map.根据来袭陨石的直径、密度、速度、入射角，估算撞击动能、TNT 当量与撞击坑大小。: From the diameter, density, velocity and incidence angle of the incoming meteorite, estimate the impact energy, the TNT equivalent and the crater size.

map.结合目标星体（地球、月球、火星）的重力与地壳参数，做跨星体撞击对比。: Combining a target body (Earth, Moon, Mars) with its gravity and crust parameters to compare impacts across bodies.
map.输入陨石参数，基于 Schmidt-Holsapple 缩放定律估算撞击动能、T: Enter the meteorite parameters and the tool estimates the impact energy, TNT equivalent, crater diameter, depth and damage radius using Schmidt-Holsapple scaling. All computation happens locally in the browser.

map.：质量 m=4/3·π·r³·ρ≈4/3·π·50³·3000≈1.57×10⁹: : mass m=4/3*π*r³*ρ≈4/3*π*50³*3000≈1.57x10⁹ kg; kinetic energy E=½mv²≈½*1.57x10⁹*(2x10⁴)²≈3.1x10¹⁷ J, about 75 megatons of TNT. Schmidt-Holsapple scaling then puts the crater diameter in the hundreds of metres.
